ModMetaData.name: Squad PTSD
ModMetaData.author: T&B Modding
ModMetaData.description:
Some soldiers come back from the worst of it changed.
An add-on for Sociopath. Works alongside Squad and Pawnicide.
Hardened by war - When a colonist who has been in combat has a sad-wandering breakdown, there is a high chance (50%) that it hardens them. They come out of it a Sociopath, and a Callous colonist becomes a full one. - A hardened colonist is marked "war-hardened" in their health tab.
Mercy killing - A war-hardened colonist decides for themselves who is beyond saving. When someone nearby is downed and beyond saving, the war-hardened colonist has a mercy-killing episode. They go to them, pause, say "Good night princess" out loud, and end it. - Beyond saving means downed and either bleeding to death within a few hours, losing to a disease their immunity can't keep up with, or dying of a condition within a day. - Anyone downed with wounds they would recover from is safe. So is anyone still on their feet. Children are never targeted. - It is a breakdown. You can't order them out of it. The way to stop it is to save the person first: stop the bleeding, and the episode ends. - The game treats it as a killing. The victim's family will hold it against them.
Works alongside Pawnicide: this mod carries its own copy of the Good Night finisher, so Pawnicide's drafted commands work exactly as before.
Combat time is counted from when this mod is added.
Requires Harmony and Sociopath. Squad and Pawnicide are optional. RimWorld 1.6, no DLC needed.
